trial_court: Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Thalassery (OP(MV) No.455 of 2012)
case_name: Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Sreedevi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: 1 Shoba.M, 2 Shamna, 3 H, and Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd
parties.respondent_defendant: Abdul Kareem, Ashiq, K.C., The Manager, The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd, and Sreedevi

facts_of_case: The petitioners are the legal heirs of the deceased third respondent. The respondents are the driver, owner of the vehicle, and the insurance company. The trial court awarded compensation to the claimants. This appeal is against that order.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the claimant to prove that the accident was caused by the negligence of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the claimant to prove that the accident was caused by the negligence of the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider all relevant evidence to determine the cause of the accident.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, this Court holds that it is necessary to consider all relevant evidence to determine the cause of the accident.

outcome.final_order: The final court order modified the earlier award by increasing the compensation amount.
